timing: After inspecting source schemas and sample records, before fitting or evaluating any prediction model.
reason: Reported USD is absent in common-scaffold model trajectories. Monetary prediction is therefore not identifiable in the preregistered population.
replacement_target: Total reported tokens, in millions, among common-scaffold runs with positive token_total and evaluation_matches_selected=true. All other split, prefix-boundary, model parameters and metrics stay fixed.
risk_alert: Training-only configuration token P90 defines high usage. Validation-only 90th percentile of predicted/P90 ratio fixes alert cutoff; never optimize against test labels.
restriction: Token volume is not money: cached/input/output prices differ, and aggregate usage does not identify remaining usage at prefix. No USD prediction or savings claim from this dataset.
original_target_status: Not executable with these fields. Preserve original protocol for audit.
